# Ahmed Ibrahim

> Ahmed Ibrahim is a senior software engineer working on voice AI at Goodcall since 2021. He offers hands-on voice agent engineering and technical consulting as an individual contributor.

Ahmed works with LiveKit, WebRTC, Python, TypeScript, speech recognition, LLM orchestration, and text-to-speech. Contact him to discuss implementation, architecture reviews, or problems in an existing agent. Scope, pricing, and availability need to be agreed directly.

- [Voice AI engineer and consultant](https://www.ahmed-ibrahim.com/voice-ai-engineer/): Services, experience, how a project starts, and answers to hiring questions.
